title: Dinosaurs and the period they lived in

FILTER(?sl >= 22) ?item wdt:P2348 ?t . ?t wdt:P361* ?per . period.match: Match each dinosaur to the period it lived in.
period.odd: Three of these dinosaurs lived in the {value} period. Which one didn't?
period.all: Tap all {n} dinosaurs that lived in the {value} period.
period.reverse: Which of these dinosaurs lived in the {value} period?

rows.label: Tyrannosaurus
rows.hook: was a massive meat-eater with tiny arms, its species name meaning "king"

rows.label: Allosaurus
rows.hook: was a big meat-eater whose name means "different lizard"

rows.label: Spinosaurus
rows.description: extinct genus of theropod dinosaurs belonging to the spinosaurid family
rows.hook: was a huge North African meat-eater named for the tall spines along its back

rows.label: Velociraptor
rows.description: extinct genus of theropod dinosaur belonging to the Dromaeosaurs
rows.hook: was a small feathered hunter with a sickle-shaped claw on each foot

rows.label: Stegosaurus
rows.hook: was a plant-eater with kite-shaped plates on its back and spikes on its tail

rows.label: Triceratops
rows.hook: was a plant-eater with a big bony frill and three horns on its face

rows.label: Archaeopteryx
rows.hook: was a feathered, bird-like creature long treated as the oldest known bird

rows.label: Giganotosaurus
rows.hook: was one of the largest meat-eaters ever to walk the land, found in Patagonia

rows.label: Ankylosaurus
rows.description: ankylosaurid dinosaur genus from the Late Cretaceous Period
rows.hook: was a heavily armored plant-eater often held up as the classic example of its group

rows.label: Brachiosaurus
rows.description: sauropod dinosaur genus from the late Jurassic Period
rows.hook: was a giant long-necked plant-eater with front limbs longer than its back ones

rows.label: Dilophosaurus
rows.hook: was an early meat-eater with a pair of crests on its skull

rows.label: Deinonychus
rows.hook: was a sharp-clawed hunter whose study launched the dinosaur renaissance

rows.label: Diplodocus
rows.hook: was a very long-necked, long-tailed plant-eater, named for double-beamed bones under its tail

rows.label: Parasaurolophus
rows.hook: was a duck-billed plant-eater with a long curved tube-shaped crest on its head

rows.label: Argentinosaurus
rows.hook: was among the largest land animals of all time, known only from fragmentary bones

rows.label: Carnotaurus
rows.hook: was a South American meat-eater with two thick horns above its eyes and tiny forelimbs

rows.label: Iguanodon
rows.hook: was a bulky plant-eater with large spikes on its thumbs

rows.label: Apatosaurus
rows.hook: was a stocky, heavily built long-necked plant-eater with air-filled bones
